stances.quote: The conditions are horrific. They amount to torture. And these people have legal protections that are ignored by ICE and the US Embassy.

stances.quote: ICE is doing this to people. Jose Mejia Hernandez can't be the only one.

stances.summary: Defends Jason Arday against anti-DEI witch hunt and eugenics advocates
stances.quote: Jason Arday didn’t harm anyone. The guy who led the social panic and hysteria aimed at Arday wants to bring back eugenics and eliminate Black people from elite institutions (and that’s likely just the beginning). So I’m not shedding any tears about his suspension.

stances.summary: Exposes double standards in anti-DEI attacks on Black academics like Jason Arday
stances.quote:
This says it all about the double standards to which Jason Arday and other Black academics have been subjected to under the guise of anti-DEI, anti-wokism, anti-affirmative action.

From Dr. Stacey Patton’s Facebook.

stances.summary: Criticizes US information restrictions as authoritarian and fascistic
stances.quote: So people in the US will literally get information only meant for the US? That is very definitely another sign of authoritarianism and fascism.

But when you're super duper in trouble--blame Canada.
